artifacts.name: Apple Account - Device List
artifacts.description: Rows of the device_list table in the Apple authentication daemon (akd) database, with device name, model, OS, serial number and the stored trust and circle status values

artifacts.name: Apple Account - Deleted Device List
artifacts.description: Rows of the deleted_device_list table in the Apple authentication daemon (akd) database, with deleted date and last updated date read as Unix seconds and the reason as stored

artifacts.name: Alarms
artifacts.description: Alarms in com.apple.mobiletimerd.plist, disabled and sleep alarms included

artifacts.name: Apple Maps Last Activity Camera
artifacts.description: Parses the last Apple Maps camera/map location (latitude and longitude) from com.apple.Maps.plist.

artifacts.name: Apple Maps Group
artifacts.description: Parses cached location coordinates from the Apple Maps app group preferences (group.com.apple.Maps.plist).

artifacts.name: Get Apple Maps search history
artifacts.description: Parses Apple Maps search history entries and timestamps from GeoHistory.mapsdata.

artifacts.name: Apple Maps Trips (routined)
artifacts.description: Examines the ZRTLEARNEDLOCATIONOFINTERESTTRANSITIONMO and ZRTLEARNEDLOCATIONOFINTERESTVISITMO tables from the routined (Significant Locations) cache, not the Apple Maps app. The Google Maps Link column holds the origin and destination coordinates as text, written by this module from the joined visit rows; it is not a stored value. Reference: Ian Whiffin, 'Locations, Locations, Locations', https://doubleblak.com/blogPost.php?k=Locations

artifacts.name: Apple Maps Significant Locations Visits (routined)
artifacts.description: Significant Location visits from the routined caches (ZRTLEARNEDLOCATIONOFINTERESTVISITMO in Local.sqlite and Cloud-V2.sqlite), with entry and exit times, coordinates and uncertainty; the Google Maps Link column repeats the coordinates as text and is not a stored value.

artifacts.name: Apple Maps Significant Locations (routined)
artifacts.description: Learned places from the routined caches (ZRTLEARNEDPLACEMO inner joined to its map item and address rows), with name, category, address fields, coordinates and creation date, followed by one row per ZRTLEARNEDLOCATIONOFINTERESTMO record with coordinates and place creation date only. The two sets are not joined to each other. A learned place with no matching address and map item row is not reported; the Google Maps Link column repeats the coordinates as text and is not a stored value.

artifacts.name: Apple Music Recently Searched
artifacts.description: One row per entry under RecentlySearched in com.apple.Music.plist, with its stored date number, kind and the identifiers archived for it.

artifacts.name: Apple Music Recent Search Terms

artifacts.name: Timers

artifacts.name: Apple Wallet Cards
artifacts.description: Card number, expiry and card type strings pattern-matched from cached Passbook API responses in the Wallet app's Cache.db, with the cache entry time; heuristic matches that need verification.

artifacts.name: Apple Wallet - PK Passes
artifacts.description: Apple wallet passes PK

artifacts.name: Apple Wallet - Nano Passes
artifacts.description: Rows of the PASS table in nanopasses.sqlite3, with the stored ingested date, organization, type, description and decoded field content

artifacts.name: Apple Wallet Transactions
artifacts.description: Wallet transactions from passes23.sqlite, with date, merchant, locality, amount and currency, location fields, peer payment handle, memo, status and type.

artifacts.name: Apple Watch Mail Synced Messages

artifacts.name: Apple Watch Mail Accounts

artifacts.name: Apple Watch Mail Mailboxes

artifacts.name: Apple Watch Photo Collections

artifacts.name: Apple Watch Photo Collection Assets

artifacts.name: Apple Watch Registry Devices

artifacts.name: Apple Watch Registry History
artifacts.description: One row per property in each entry of DeviceRegistry.state/history.plist, with the entry date, device identifier, property name and value.

artifacts.name: Apple Watch Weather Cities
artifacts.description: One row per entry in the Cities list of com.apple.nanoweatherprefs.plist, with its name, country abbreviation and stored coordinates.

artifacts.name: WiFi Scanned Networks (Private)

artifacts.name: WiFi BSS List
artifacts.description: Parses BSS (Basic Service Set) information for known WiFi networks

artifacts.description: Extraction of different World Clock entries

artifacts.description: Extract information about bundle container path and data path for Applications

artifacts.name: Application Snapshot
artifacts.description: Extract XBApplicationSnapshotManifest records from applicationState.db, using the stored creationDate as the primary timestamp. The value is the creationDate property of SplashBoard's snapshot object; the event that sets it is not publicly documented. It does not by itself prove foreground application use or that the user viewed the image contents.

artifacts.name: Application Snapshot lastUsedDate
artifacts.description: Extract XBApplicationSnapshotManifest records with a lastUsedDate from applicationState.db. The property belongs to SplashBoard's snapshot object, but its update event is not publicly documented. A record whose stored lastUsedDate is an empty string is left out. The value must not be treated as proof that the application was in the foreground or that the user viewed the image contents at that time.

artifacts.name: App Snapshots
artifacts.description: Snapshots saved by iOS for individual apps. KTX images are converted to PNG for display, and XBApplicationSnapshotManifest metadata is joined when applicationState.db is available. KTX files smaller than 2500 bytes and KTX files that do not decode are left out.

artifacts.name: App Store - Searches
artifacts.description: Search terms the App Store app sent to its search API, recovered from the cached search and suggestion requests; a cached request does not establish that the term was submitted by the user

artifacts.name: App Store - Cached Requests

artifacts.name: Ash Shell History
artifacts.description: Extracts command history from an ash shell history file (.ash_history)

artifacts.name: iOS ATXDatastore
artifacts.description: Rows of the alog table in _ATXDataStore.db that have a matching alogAction row, with their action type. Latitude and Longitude are those of the routined learned location of interest (Local.sqlite) whose identifier equals the row's location value, and are blank when none matches. No rows are reported unless both databases are present.

artifacts.name: Battery Data Collection (BDC) - Daily

artifacts.name: Battery Data Collection (BDC) - OBC

artifacts.name: Battery Data Collection (BDC) - SmartCharging

artifacts.name: Battery UI - Snapshots and Upgrade Marker

artifacts.name: Biome - Airplane Mode DKEvent
artifacts.description: Parses airplane mode entries from biomes

artifacts.name: Biome - App Activity
artifacts.description: Parses NSUserActivity records from the App.Activity biome stream: bundle id, activity type, linked item URI and an activity payload that can embed content such as note titles or map activity details.

artifacts.name: Biome - App Install
artifacts.description: App install entries from the App.Install and _DKEvent.App.Install Biome streams

artifacts.name: Biome - App Installation
artifacts.description: Parses app installation events from the App.Installation biome stream: the bundle identifier, a UUID stored with the bundle identifier, two version strings and two record timestamps. The field names follow Mattia Epifani, '84 Streams Later, Part 2: Inside Apple Biome', https://blog.digital-forensics.it/2026/07/84-streams-later-part-2-inside-apple.html; their meaning is not established. See also the App.Install and _DKEvent.App.Install streams.

artifacts.name: Biome - App Intents Transcript
artifacts.description: Parses records from the App.Intents.Transcript biome stream: a bundle identifier, an intent class name, parameter names and entity titles. The record is decoded without a schema and the field names are working labels.

artifacts.name: Biome - Apple Intelligence Availability
artifacts.description: Parses records from the AppleIntelligence.Availability biome stream: three state values reported raw and a language string.

artifacts.name: Biome - Apple Intelligence Asset Availability
artifacts.description: Parses Apple Intelligence asset availability reporting from the AppleIntelligence.Reporting.AssetDeliveryLog.Availability biome stream: strings labelled here as client, attribute and OS build. The record is decoded without a schema and the labels are not confirmed by a source.

artifacts.name: Biome - Apple Intelligence Model Catalog
artifacts.description: Parses Apple Intelligence model catalog activity from the AppleIntelligence.Reporting.AssetDeliveryLog.ModelCatalog biome stream. Each record carries a feature or client name and an attribute and value, which on the tested image included a language. What event writes a record is not established, and neither is user exercise of the feature.

artifacts.name: Biome - Apple Intelligence Software Update
artifacts.description: Parses Apple Intelligence software update controller reporting from the AppleIntelligence.Reporting.AssetDeliveryLog.SoftwareUpdateController biome stream.

artifacts.name: Biome - Apple Intelligence Safety Overrides
artifacts.description: Parses Apple Intelligence safety override reporting from the AppleIntelligence.Reporting.SafetyOverrides biome stream. On the tested sample no record was in the written state, and only the SEGB timestamp of each deleted record was reported. What event writes a record is not established.

artifacts.name: Biome - Apple Intelligence Unified Asset
artifacts.description: Parses Apple Intelligence unified asset framework reporting from the AppleIntelligence.Reporting.AssetDeliveryLog.UnifiedAssetFramework biome stream: values labelled here as asset ID, client and user ID. The record is decoded without a schema and the labels are not confirmed by a source.

artifacts.name: Biome DB - App Openings
artifacts.description: Per-launch application records (bundle ID, event time, launch type) pre-aggregated by Apple in the ApplePay.Security.Features Biome database.

artifacts.name: Biome DB - App Openings (Hourly)
artifacts.description: Hourly per-application launch counts pre-aggregated by Apple in the ApplePay.Security.Features Biome database.

artifacts.name: Biome DB - Cable Plug Events
artifacts.description: Cable connection/disconnection events pre-aggregated by Apple in the ApplePay.Security.Features Biome database.

artifacts.name: Biome DB - Backlight Events
artifacts.description: Screen backlight level change events pre-aggregated by Apple in the ApplePay.Security.Features Biome database.

artifacts.name: Biome DB - Button Clicks (Daily)
artifacts.description: Per-day button click counts pre-aggregated by Apple in the ApplePay.Security.Features Biome database.

artifacts.name: Biome DB - Minimum Battery (Daily)
artifacts.description: Per-day minimum battery percentage pre-aggregated by Apple in the ApplePay.Security.Features Biome database.

artifacts.name: Biome DB - CarPlay Activity (Daily)
artifacts.description: Per-day CarPlay activity counts pre-aggregated by Apple in the ApplePay.Security.Features Biome database.

artifacts.name: Biome DB - Audio Route (Daily)
artifacts.description: Per-day audio route counts with the route type, external flag and route change reason as stored, pre-aggregated by Apple in the ApplePay.Security.Features Biome database.

artifacts.name: Biome - App Location Activity
artifacts.description: Parses NSUserActivity records that carry place details from the App.LocationActivity biome stream: the donating app, the activity type and payload, the web page or item involved, and the associated street address, city and postal code. TIMESTAMP CAUTION: the timestamps require caution. On the tested images many records shared one SEGB time, so the SEGB record time is not taken as the moment of the activity, and the other timestamp on the record is an expiry roughly 30 days ahead. Corroborate any time here against another source before relying on it.

artifacts.name: Biome - App Relevant Shortcuts
artifacts.description: Parses relevant shortcuts donated by apps from the App.RelevantShortcuts biome stream: the donating app, the widgetKind value, and the start and end dates of the first relevance provider in the embedded plist, reported as stored.

artifacts.name: Biome - App Web Usage
artifacts.description: Parses App Web Usage entries from Biome

artifacts.name: Biome - Audio Route
artifacts.description: Parses audio route changes from the Audio.Route biome stream: the route name, its port type and the port name (for example Built-In Microphone / MicrophoneBuiltIn / iPhone Microphone).

artifacts.name: Biome - Media Route
artifacts.description: Parses media output route changes from the Media.Route biome stream. Rows carry a route name and, where stored, a route identifier; route type and subtype are reported raw.

artifacts.name: Biome - Autonaming Message IDs
artifacts.description: Parses message references (message GUID, conversation identifier and message date) from the Autonaming.Messages.MessageIds biome stream. The purpose of the stream is not established.

artifacts.name: Biome - Backlight
artifacts.description: Parses backlight entries from biomes

artifacts.name: Biome - Battery Percentage
artifacts.description: Parses battery percentage entries from biomes

artifacts.name: Biome - Bluetooth
artifacts.description: Parses Bluetooth device entries from biomes

artifacts.name: Biome - Boot Session
artifacts.description: Parses boot session records from the Device.BootSession biome stream. Each record carries a session identifier and a state, labelled 1 Session Start and 0 Session End; those labels are inferred from the record pattern and the stored value is in Session State (raw). What a gap between an end and the next start shows is not established here.

artifacts.name: Biome - Camera Auto Focus ROI
artifacts.description: Parses camera autofocus region of interest events from the CameraCapture.AutoFocusROI biome stream. Each record carries a camera port string. What action writes a record is not established here.

artifacts.name: Biome - Carplay
artifacts.description: Parses carplay is connected entries from biomes

artifacts.name: Biome - Clock Alarm
artifacts.description: Parses alarm state changes from the Clock.Alarm biome stream, including the alarm identifier.

artifacts.name: Biome - Device Metadata
artifacts.description: Parses OS build records from the Device.Metadata biome stream. Each record carries an OS build string and a SEGB timestamp.

artifacts.name: Biome - Interface Orientation
artifacts.description: Parses interface orientation changes from the Device.Display.InterfaceOrientation biome stream.

artifacts.name: Biome - Low Power Mode
artifacts.description: Parses Low Power Mode transitions from the Device.Power.LowPowerMode biome stream.

artifacts.name: Biome - Airplane Mode
artifacts.description: Parses Airplane Mode transitions from the Device.Wireless.AirplaneMode biome stream.

artifacts.name: Biome - Cellular Data Enabled
artifacts.description: Parses cellular data enable and disable events from the Device.Wireless.CellularDataEnabled biome stream.

artifacts.name: Biome - CarPlay Connected
artifacts.description: Parses CarPlay connection state changes from the CarPlay.Connected biome stream.

artifacts.name: Biome - Battery Temperature
artifacts.description: Parses battery temperature samples from the Device.Thermals.BatteryTemperature biome stream.

artifacts.name: Biome - Screen Locked
artifacts.description: Parses screen lock and unlock events from the Device.ScreenLocked biome stream.

artifacts.name: Biome - Keybag Locked
artifacts.description: Parses keybag lock state changes from the Device.KeybagLocked biome stream. The keybag holds the class keys that protect file data; the stream records its locked state over time.

artifacts.name: Biome - Battery Level
artifacts.description: Parses battery level samples from the Device.Power.BatteryLevel biome stream.

artifacts.name: Biome - Power Plugged In
artifacts.description: Parses charger connect and disconnect events from the Device.Power.PluggedIn biome stream.

artifacts.name: Biome - Energy Mode
artifacts.description: Parses energy mode changes from the Device.Power.EnergyMode biome stream.

artifacts.name: Biome - Silent Mode
artifacts.description: Parses ringer switch and silent mode changes from the Device.SilentMode biome stream, including the reason string stored with the record, reported as stored.

artifacts.name: Biome - Device Plugged In
artifacts.description: Parses device plugged in entries from biomes

artifacts.name: Biome - Device TimeZone
artifacts.description: Parses historical device time zone records from the Device.TimeZone biome stream

artifacts.name: Biome - WiFi Devices
artifacts.description: Parses SSID and connection status records from the Device.Wireless.WiFi biome stream. Connect (As Stored) is the integer stored in field 2. Status reads Connected where that value is 1, Disconnected where it is 0, and is blank for any other value. The same two status names are listed for this stream in Mattia Epifani, '84 Streams Later, Part 2: Inside Apple Biome', https://blog.digital-forensics.it/2026/07/84-streams-later-part-2-inside-apple.html

artifacts.name: Biome - Discoverability Signals
artifacts.description: Parses feature signals from the Discoverability.Signals biome stream. Each written record carries a signal name as stored (the names seen include ones that refer to Face ID face coverings, Wallet transactions and photos moved to the trash), together with the value or JSON payload stored with it. What causes a signal to be written is not established.

artifacts.name: Biome - Audio Input Route DKEvent
artifacts.description: Parses audio input route events from the _DKEvent.Audio.InputRoute biome stream. Route details are reported as stored in the Metadata column.

artifacts.name: Biome - Audio Output Route DKEvent
artifacts.description: Parses audio output route events from the _DKEvent.Audio.OutputRoute biome stream. Route details are reported as stored in the Metadata column.

artifacts.name: Biome - Clock Alarm DKEvent
artifacts.description: Parses alarm state changes from the _DKEvent.Clock.Alarm biome stream. Metadata is reported as stored.

artifacts.name: Biome - Screen Lock Imputed DKEvent
artifacts.description: Parses records from the _DKEvent.Device.IsLockedImputed biome stream. The stored value is reported in Value (raw) without a Locked or Unlocked label.

artifacts.name: Biome - Low Power Mode DKEvent
artifacts.description: Parses Low Power Mode records from the _DKEvent.Device.LowPowerMode biome stream. Value reads Off for 0 and On for 1, with the stored value in Value (raw). Reference: Mattia Epifani, '84 Streams Later, Part 2: Inside Apple Biome', https://blog.digital-forensics.it/2026/07/84-streams-later-part-2-inside-apple.html

artifacts.name: Biome - Display Orientation DKEvent
artifacts.description: Parses records from the _DKEvent.Display.Orientation biome stream. The stored value is reported in Value (raw) without an orientation label.

artifacts.name: Biome - Siri UI DKEvent
artifacts.description: Parses Siri interface events from the _DKEvent.Siri.Ui biome stream. Start and end timestamps are reported where the record stores them.

artifacts.name: Biome - Do Not Disturb DKEvent
artifacts.description: Parses records from the _DKEvent.Settings.DoNotDisturb biome stream. No source was found for what the stored values mean on this stream, so the Value column is left empty and the stored value is reported in Value (raw).

artifacts.name: Biome - In Focus DKEvent

artifacts.description: A file named device_values.plist found anywhere in the input is read, and each key and value is listed as stored, with the file it came from. When exactly one such file is found and its ProductVersion is digits separated by dots, and no iOS version has been set earlier in the run, ProductVersion becomes the iOS version for the rest of the run, which decides which version-specific queries other artifacts use. artifacts.name: Telegram Accounts
artifacts.description: Parses Telegram account records from the accounts-metadata atomic-state file and each account's Postbox database (table t0). Reports the account IDs registered on the device, which one was active, the signed-in user ID, the production/test environment flag, and the key names of the accessChallengeData object, reported as stored.

artifacts.name: Telegram Contacts & Peers
artifacts.description: Parses cached peer records (users, bots, groups, channels, secret chats) from table t2 of each Telegram account's Postbox database, joined with the contact list (table t16), the Spotlight contact cache, and cached avatar images. A peer record can be present without any exchanged messages and without being a saved contact; the Messages In Chat column is 0 and In Contact List is blank for such peers.

artifacts.name: Telegram Chats
artifacts.description: Parses the Telegram chat list from the Postbox chat list table, reporting each entry with the time of its top message, whether it is pinned, the group it sits in (main list, archive or the stored group id), the number of messages stored for it, the unread count and the entry type.

artifacts.name: Telegram Device Contacts
artifacts.description: Parses the device address-book entries Telegram recorded for contact import, from table t54 of each account's Postbox database. Each entry is keyed by a phone number from the device address book and carries the name as stored on the device, the import state (imported or retry later), the importers count the server returned for the number (Telegram API popularContact: 'How many people imported this contact'), and the Telegram user the number resolved to when it resolved to one. A record can be stored without a Telegram user id (the client declares peerId as optional), so a row is a device address-book number the client processed for import, not a Telegram contact.

artifacts.name: Telegram Peer Presence
artifacts.description: Parses cached presence records from table t20 of each Telegram account's Postbox database. Reports the current decoder's v and h values beside the status interpretation and h truthiness, with Last Activity and Status Time.

artifacts.name: Telegram Message Tags
artifacts.description: Parses the per-message category index Telegram maintains in table t12 of each account's Postbox database. Each row ties a stored message to a category such as photo, video, file, music, voice, link or pinned, so the messages of one kind within a chat can be listed from the index alone.

artifacts.name: Telegram Cached Peer Details
artifacts.description: Parses the cached peer detail records Telegram stores for users and channels in table t18 of each account's Postbox database. Reports the profile bio or channel description, a user's stored birthday, whether a user is blocked, the number of groups in common, scheduled-message and auto-delete state, and who invited the account to a channel. A row does not show whether any message was exchanged with the peer; this artifact does not read the message table.

artifacts.name: Telegram Settings
artifacts.description: Parses named Telegram settings from the shared accounts-metadata table t2 and account Postbox table t35. Headline settings receive a placeholder when no supported stored record is reported for the key. That placeholder does not establish whether the app uses a default value.

artifacts.name: Telegram Messages
artifacts.description: Parses Telegram messages, including text, media, and forwarding information from the local cache database. The Chat/Chat ID columns identify the conversation; the Author/Author ID columns identify the sender of each individual message. Direction is Incoming when the stored flags carry the Incoming bit and Outgoing otherwise. Account ID is the number in the account folder name the database was read from.

artifacts.description: NO MESSAGE CONTENT. Wickr stores message text encrypted and it is not recovered here. This artifact reports message metadata only: the timestamp, the conversation, the sending user, the read and delivery timestamps, the stored type values and any attached file

artifacts.name: Wickr - Conversations (No Names)
artifacts.description: NO CONVERSATION NAMES. Wickr stores room names and descriptions encrypted and they are not recovered here. This artifact reports the group identifier, the kind of conversation, the last message and sync timestamps, the users linked to the conversation record and the users linked to the secure room record

artifacts.name: Wickr - Users (Hashes Only)
artifacts.description: NO USER NAMES. Wickr stores user names and aliases encrypted and they are not recovered here. Users are identified only by the stored hash values. This artifact reports those hashes, the network membership flags and the last activity timestamp

artifacts.name: Wickr - Files (Metadata Only)
artifacts.description: NO FILE NAMES OR CONTENT. Wickr stores file titles and mime types encrypted, and the attachment files themselves are not decoded here. This artifact reports the file GUID, the stored status value and the message each file is linked to

artifacts.name: Wickr - Account Settings
artifacts.description: The Wickr account row, with the security group identifier, the notification and lock settings and the stored ZAFENABLE and ZAFSPEED values

artifacts.name: Wickr - Secex_App Records
artifacts.description: Rows selected from ZSECEX_APP with linked ZSECEX_USER values from wickrLocal.sqlite.

artifacts.name: Wickr - Recent Searches
artifacts.description: Entries held in the Wickr recent search table, with the stored query text and its timestamp

artifacts.name: Wickr - Account Identity (Keychain)
artifacts.description: The Wickr account identity held in the iOS keychain, including the user name in the clear, the device identifier and the stored baseURL value. Needs a keychain, supplied or carried by the extraction

artifacts.name: Wickr - App Log Message Events
artifacts.description: Notification payload and Download Message lines recorded in the Wickr application logs, with the log timestamp, the message and conversation identifiers, the payload's userId value as decoded from JSON and the logged message type

artifacts.name: Widgets
artifacts.description: Snapshot images from the com.apple.chrono snapshot-cache folder. Dates and times shown are from file modified timestamps

artifacts.name: Wi-Fi Analytics - Geotags
artifacts.description: Wi-Fi geotags from DeviceAnalyticsModel.sqlite in the com.apple.wifianalyticsd directory, with the linked BSSID and SSID

artifacts.name: Network Interface Identifiers
artifacts.description: Extracts MAC addresses of all interfaces listed in NetworkInterfaces.plist (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular and others)

artifacts.name: WiFi Network Store - Networks
artifacts.description: Network records from the WiFiNetworkStoreModel store, with counts of the geotag records linked to each

artifacts.name: WiFi Network Store - Geotags
artifacts.description: Geotag records from the WiFiNetworkStoreModel store, with the SSIDs of the network records they are linked to

artifacts.name: Wipe Indicators
artifacts.description: Reports source metadata times for /root/.obliterated and /root/.bootstrapped from the seeker's FileInfo

artifacts.name: Wire Secure Messenger Account
artifacts.description: Wire users joined to the clients recorded for them (ZUSER LEFT JOIN ZUSERCLIENT), one row per user and client, with handle, display name, phone and email as stored, the user ID as a UUID, and each client's ID, device class, label, model and activation, discovery and last active dates, and, where the schema has them, the client's activation location as Latitude and Longitude. The query is not limited to the account signed in on the device.

artifacts.name: Wire Secure Messenger Messages
artifacts.description: Wire messages, including the sender's handle, user ID and display name, and message type

artifacts.name: Health Mate - Accounts
artifacts.description: The account recorded in the Health Mate app's Application Support/account file, with user id, names, birthdate and email and its creation and modification times.

artifacts.name: Health Mate - Sleep Tracking
artifacts.description: ZTRACK records with no subcategory and ZTYPE 36 from the Health Mate app's Core Data track store, which the cited post identifies as tracked sleep on its test device, with start and end, sleep stage durations, time to sleep and to get up, wake-up count and the device id.

artifacts.name: Health Mate - Daily Summary
artifacts.description: ZTRACK records with no track id and no device id from the Health Mate app's Core Data track store, which the cited post identifies as the summary of a day on its test device, with the day's inactive, soft, moderate and intense durations, steps and distance.

artifacts.name: Health Mate - Tracked Activities
artifacts.description: ZTRACK records that have an activity subcategory, a track extension record and a step value in the Health Mate app's Core Data track store, with start and end, type, durations, the ZMIN, ZMAX and ZAVG values of the track extension (as stored), step, distance, speed and temperature values and start, end and region centre coordinates as stored.

artifacts.name: Health Mate - Messages
artifacts.description: Rows of type HMTimelineMessageEvent from the ZHMTIMELINEEVENT table of the Health Mate timeline store, with sender, receiver, type and text as stored.

artifacts.name: Health Mate - Measurements
artifacts.description: Rows of the ZVASISTAS table of the Health Mate measurements store, as stored.

artifacts.name: Health Mate - Devices
artifacts.description: Rows of the ZWTDEVICE table of the Health Mate associated device store, as stored.

artifacts.name: Zalo - Chats
artifacts.description: Messages from the ChatContent table of each Zalo chat database under Documents/chat_dbs, for one to one and group chats, with the attached file where one is found.

artifacts.name: Zalo - Stored Profile Entries
artifacts.description: Stored ProfileEntity rows from the selected profile.sqlite, with mobile values joined from BuddyEntity and optional globalid values from GlobalIdEntity.

artifacts.name: Zangi Chats
artifacts.description: Messages from the ZZANGIMESSAGE table of zangidb.sqlite, with the name and number of the ZZNUMBER row the message's ZFROM value points to. Direction is SENT when ZISRECEIVED is 0 and RECEIVED when it is 1; no source for that reading is recorded here.

artifacts.name: Zangi Messenger - Messages
artifacts.description: Messages from the Zangi Messenger database, joined to its conversation, group and contact tables, with direction, sender, chat name, text, message type and the attachment file where one is found by name among the image, video, file and voice folders of the app group folder that holds the database (by message id, by the stored media path, or for documents by the message text); only voice note and image rows fill Attachment File, other types fill Attachment Link. Reads two database layouts: the older ZZANGIMESSAGE table and the newer ZZMESSAGE family, whichever a database carries.

artifacts.name: Zangi Messenger - Contacts
artifacts.description: Contacts from the Zangi Messenger database (ZCONTACT with its numbers), with names, number, email, number type name, blocked and favourite flags and modification and activity times. The modification time is read as seconds from 2001 and the activity time as Unix time; neither reading has been checked on data here, because the one image recorded in sample_data returned no contact rows.

artifacts.name: Zangi Messenger - Accounts
artifacts.description: Account rows from the ZUSER table of the Zangi Messenger database, with the number stored as ZNUMBER (shown as Account ID), names, email, status, registration status, country, the passcode, password, PIN and hidden conversation PIN (shown as Conversation Hiding Password) fields as stored, and ZSTATUSLASTSYNCTIME read as Unix time (shown as Last Sync Timestamp).

artifacts.name: Zoom - Chat Messages
artifacts.description: Chat messages stored in Zoom per-conversation tables, with sentByMe as stored, the existing parser direction interpretation and the linked file where resolved.

artifacts.name: Zoom - Call History
artifacts.description: Calls the Zoom app recorded, with the two parties and the coded direction, length and state each row stores.

artifacts.name: Zoom - Shared Files
artifacts.description: Zoom file-table entries with sentByMe as stored, the existing parser direction interpretation and the linked local copy where resolved.

artifacts.name: Zoom - Giphy Images
artifacts.description: Animations recorded in the Zoom store giphy table, with the address and the copy stored on the device where there is one.

artifacts.name: Extraction Info
artifacts.description: Identifiers for this extraction and parse run: LEAPP version, input path, extraction type, iOS version and device identifiers when available. Written to the LAVA database so batch tooling can tell which device/extraction the data came from.

artifacts.name: Installed App Inventory
artifacts.description: Canonical installed application inventory: one row per app container (bundle, data, shared group, plugin) with its bundle ID, container path and UUID. Sources: applicationState.db and .com.apple.mobile_container_manager.metadata.plist files.

artifacts.name: App File Inventory
artifacts.description: Complete file listing of the extraction with each file mapped to the app container (bundle ID) it belongs to, when applicable. Supports coverage analysis of which apps/files the tooling parsed. LAVA only due to size.
